mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 220 (CPIAUCSL), it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals a recessionary environment with accommodative monetary policy, which typically precedes a rebound in equity markets, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE > 8.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5, or the interaction term in regression has negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic momentum, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and supply capacity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 0.5% in the past three months, it signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust aggregate demand and consumer confidence, which typically drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST growth exceed 0.5%, or the interaction term in regression has negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 220, it signals persistent inflation that leads to a 60-day negative S&P 500 return as the market prices in prolonged monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
